description: Filter, project and aggregate the rows of ONE sheet of the ACTIVE workbook by column values — served by the calculation engine in milliseconds on any sheet size. This is the tool for "which rows have Acme in the Owner column", "stores with revenue >= 100 opened after 2026-01-01", or "total revenue by region": one call, instead of scanning with read_range or writing a script. Columns are column letters ("DB") or header texts from the sheet's header row ("Revenue ($m)", case-insensitive, unique substrings accepted); the header row is auto-detected (override with `header_row`). `where` lists predicates that are ANDed: `op` is one of eq, ne, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, gt, gte, lt, lte, between (value = [low, high]), in / not_in (value = list), empty, not_empty. Text compares case-insensitively and trimmed, numbers numerically, dates as ISO strings ("2026-01-01") against date-formatted cells. Returns the matching rows — 1-indexed `row` plus the requested `columns` keyed by column letter (date-formatted numbers come back as ISO dates) — up to `limit` (default 50, max 500), with `matched` = the total count and `truncated`. With `group_by`, returns one entry per distinct value with `count` and each requested `aggregate` (sum / count / min / max / avg) instead of rows. Read-only, evaluated values (set `include_formulas` for formulas too). Row numbers in the reply are exact — use them directly in formulas or read_range.

aggregate.description: With group_by: aggregates to compute per group (e.g. sum of Revenue). Groups are ordered by the first aggregate, descending.

columns.description: Columns to return (letters or header texts). Default: the header-row columns, up to 40.

end_row.description: Last data row to scan (default: the sheet's last row).

group_by.description: Group matching rows by this column's value and return one entry per value instead of rows.

header_row.description: 1-indexed header row, when auto-detection picks the wrong one.

include_formulas.description: Return {v, f} for formula cells instead of the bare value.

limit.description: Max rows (or groups) to return. Default 50.

order_by.description: Sort matches by a column before applying `limit` (numbers before text, blanks last).

path.description: Path of the .xlsx to operate on (absolute, or ~/… for the user's home directory).

start_row.description: First data row to scan (default: the row after the header).

where.description: Predicates, all of which must hold. Omit for every row.

value.description: Comparison value: string, number, ISO date, or a list for between / in / not_in. Omit for empty / not_empty.

name: query_rows
